Set up GPU support

Source: R/gpu.R
birdnet_use_gpu.Rd

Declares the Python packages BirdNET needs to run on a GPU. Call it once at the top of a script, before Python starts (loading a model, birdnet_sitrep() and the birdnet_list_*() functions that use Python all start it): the packages are resolved when Python starts, so afterwards it is too late and the function errors (restart R and call it first).

Usage

birdnet_use_gpu(backend = c("pt", "pb"))

Arguments

backend

"pt" (PyTorch, default) or "pb" (TensorFlow).

Value

Invisibly returns TRUE. If RETICULATE_PYTHON points at your own Python environment, birdnetR cannot install anything there: the function warns and returns FALSE.

Details

Choose one backend per R session. TensorFlow ("pb") and PyTorch ("pt") each bring their own CUDA libraries, and installing both can conflict, so asking for the other backend later in the same session is an error.

Requirements by platform:

  • Linux, "pt" (default): installs birdnet[pt]. If the environment variable UV_TORCH_BACKEND is not set, it is set to "auto" so that uv picks the torch build matching your GPU driver. For AMD GPUs, set e.g. Sys.setenv(UV_TORCH_BACKEND = "rocm7.2") before calling birdnet_use_gpu() (ROCm support is experimental).

  • Linux, "pb": installs birdnet[and-cuda]. An NVIDIA driver and CUDA must already be installed on the system. TensorFlow 2.21.0 is left out, because it does not find the GPU.

  • macOS (Apple silicon), "pb": installs birdnet[tf] plus tensorflow-metal.

Any other combination (for example Windows) has no automatic setup and errors; vignette("gpu", package = "birdnetR") shows how to set up your own Python environment instead, and covers everything else about GPUs.

Afterwards, load a model for the chosen backend with birdnet_load(backend = "pt") (or birdnet_load_perch(device = "GPU")) and use device = "GPU" in birdnet_predict() and birdnet_encode().

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# at the top of a script, before loading any model
birdnet_use_gpu("pt")
model <- birdnet_load("acoustic", "3.0", backend = "pt")
audio_file <- system.file("extdata", "soundscape.mp3", package = "birdnetR")
pred <- birdnet_predict(model, audio_file, device = "GPU")

# AMD GPU (experimental)
Sys.setenv(UV_TORCH_BACKEND = "rocm7.2")
birdnet_use_gpu("pt")
} # }
